result: I write to just let out my thoughts and feelings on any topic that comes to my mind. I write without any rules, restrictions or preconceived notions. I write just to express myself and to share my perspectives with the world. At times, my writings may be abstract or nonsensical, but that is okay. I write for myself and not to please anyone else. I write to explore new ideas and to challenge my own beliefs. I write to live life on my own terms and to achieve inner peace. I write to express the pain, pleasure and emotions of life. I write to understand myself and the world better. This is my freedom of expression and I write what I feel like writing.
